text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Make Debut!
Damn, just the sound of that is crazy cool...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we're really here, right?
If I dash outside, that's the paddock, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, this isn't like a mock race!
âIt's a life-or-death, all-out showdown!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Let's do this!!

Striding forward gallantly, Vodka
scanned the paddock. And then—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Something's off... Something is definitely off!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Take a look around at everyone...

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to do my best!
*clap clap*

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The first race is... basically like practice, right?
Easy does it, nice and relaxed♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This ain't it! The Debut Race
is supposed to have way more fire than this!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ugh, so annoying! Every single one of them comes at me half-cocked!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right, just watch me.
I'll show ya what real determination looks like!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna leave 'em all in the dust,
so keep your eyes peeled!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, there's an Umamusume who's
looking awfully confident!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
I hope for your sake you're not all talk.
If you get crushed after saying all that... Pfft!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
............
Hey, Trainer, can I ask you something real quick...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I get totally crushed here,
wouldn't that make me the weakest Umamusume around, losing to a bunch of softies?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! Seriously!?
That's so lame... Totally and utterly lame~!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'm gonna let that happen!
I'll do it, I'll definitely do it, Trainer!!

I send her off with all the cheers I've got.
Hoping this high energy
doesn't just end up spinning its wheels...!
